items: Objective: To enhance the capacity of civil servants (Centre, States, UTs) to be more creative,
proactive, professional, energetic, transparent, and technology-enabled.
 iGOT Karmayogi Platform: Digital learning platform for continuous role-based training.
 World Bank Support: Financial and technical assistance.
 Capacity Building Commission (CBC): Standardizes and monitors training.
 Special Purpose Vehicle: Karmayogi Bharat to oversee implementation.
 Focus: Behavioral skills, leadership, and citizen-centric governance.
